warningsRetained: Offline mode and synthetic clients are confined to loopback; this is not online-account or hardware authentication proof.
Grim warns Java 8 support will end; Paper 1.16.5 also warns about future Java requirements. No claim of current upstream support is made.

Paper 1.16.5 final fixture still logs No key layers/structures in MapLike[{}] and spawn-biome warnings. Explicit forceload plus fill created the validated 8448-block scene; the generator is not claimed repaired.
Legacy api-version/material warnings, terminal warnings, double-disconnection warnings and existing text encoding artifacts remain in original console logs.
limits: 42 means three successful profiles each with eight trigger groups and six restart groups. Partial assertions in failed attempts are not counted.
BadPacketsA alone reached x120 after 121 duplicate-slot packets at 160ms spacing under the complete unchanged 120:0 template.
The linked pair is historical: the first account disconnected before the second was sanctioned. This does not test simultaneous online linked-player eviction.
Mode 1 concealment was tested at the named buried/exposed/stone coordinates only. No mining reveal-update, general xray resistance, false-positive rate, gameplay, latency or performance guarantee.
1.8.8 and 1.12.2 retain raw logs, executed decoder snapshots and decoded ore evidence; raw chunk payloads were only captured for 1.16.5.
The newly changed 37-rule default catalog and automation DENY sanction fix are source-only follow-ups and are absent from the frozen E119 product used here.
